The existing APIs provide the needed data, so this can stay a focused frontend change. The popup will show member names and emails, directly assigned assets with type/IP/owner, assigned AWS account IDs, and AD domains. It will also show the group’s status and AD owner, and make loading failures visible so they cannot look like empty lists.

I’m applying the repository’s `secure-code`, `e2ejs`, and `e2evulnexception` skills. The new view will reuse authenticated requests and server-side workgroup checks; all mutating tests will run in a disposable database.
